def sha(body):
    return hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest()

def identity(path):
    body = path.read_bytes()
    return {'path': str(path), 'sha256': sha(body), 'size_bytes': len(body)}

def load(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

def slug(value):
    value = html.unescape(value).lower()
    value = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]*\)', r'\1', value)
    value = re.sub(r'<[^>]*>', '', value)
    value = ''.join(c for c in value if c in ' -_' or unicodedata.category(c)[0] in 'LNM')
    return value.replace(' ', '-')

def anchors(path):
    text = path.read_text()
    result = set(re.findall(r'<a\s+(?:id|name)=["\']([^"\']+)', text))
    counts = collections.Counter()
    fenced = False
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if re.match(r'^\s*(```|~~~)', line):
            fenced = not fenced
        if fenced:
            continue
        match = re.match(r'^#{1,6}\s+(.+?)\s*#*\s*$', line)
        if match:
            base = slug(match.group(1))
            result.add(base if counts[base] == 0 else base + '-' + str(counts[base]))
            counts[base] += 1
    return result

links = []
external = []
private_markers = []
for name in FILES:
    body = (ROOT / name).read_text()
    for match in re.finditer(r'\[[^\]\n]+\]\(([^)\n]+)\)', body):
        literal = match.group(1).strip()
        if re.match(r'^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.-]*:', literal):
            external.append({'document': name, 'target': literal})
            continue
        target_text, _, fragment = literal.partition('#')
        target = (ROOT / name).parent / urllib.parse.unquote(target_text) if target_text else ROOT / name
        target = target.resolve()
        row = {'document': name, 'line': body[:match.start()].count('\n') + 1,
               'target': literal, 'exists': target.exists()}
        if fragment:
            row['anchor_exists'] = (target.is_file() and target.suffix == '.md'
                and urllib.parse.unquote(fragment) in anchors(target))
        links.append(row)
    for marker in ('libfile_', 'oai-library://', 'account_id=personal'):
        if marker in body:
            private_markers.append({'document': name, 'marker': marker})

def visit(value, path='root'):

            visit(item, path + '.' + key)
    elif isinstance(value, list):

            visit(item, path + '[' + str(index) + ']')
